complaint.intro: Plaintiff [[Plaintiff Name]], through undersigned counsel, complains against Defendants [[Defendant One]] and [[Defendant Two]] and alleges as follows:

paragraphs.text: Plaintiff [[Name]] (“[[Short Name]]”) is [[an individual residing in ___ County, Utah / a Utah limited liability company with its principal place of business in ___ County, Utah]].

[[CONTRACTOR PLAINTIFFS ONLY (Utah Code § 58-55-604): At all relevant times, including when each contract sued upon was entered into and when each cause of action arose, [Short Name] was appropriately licensed under the Utah Construction Trades Licensing Act (License No. ___; classifications ___). Delete otherwise.]]
Defendant [[Name]] (“[[Short Name]]”) is [[an individual residing in ___ County, Utah]].
Defendant [[Name]] (“[[Short Name]]”) is [[a Utah corporation with its principal place of business in ___ County, Utah; its registered agent is ___]].
This Court has subject-matter jurisdiction under Utah Code § 78A-5-102(1).
This Court has personal jurisdiction over Defendants because [[each resides in / is organized under the laws of / transacted the business at issue in]] Utah.

Venue is proper in [[___]] County under Utah Code § 78B-3a-201 because [[a defendant resides in ___ County at the commencement of this action / the cause of action arose in ___ County]]. [[For an entity defendant, residence is determined under § 78B-3a-104.]]

[[Plaintiff seeks damages of $50,000 or less / more than $50,000 and less than $300,000 / $300,000 or more]]. Under Rule 26(c)(3) of the Utah Rules of Civil Procedure, this is a Tier [[1/2/3]] action. [[Compute without duplicating alternative theories, URCP 26(c)(4). Tier 1 and 2 waive damages above the cap, URCP 8(a).]]

[[One fact per paragraph, in chronological order. Define terms once (the “Agreement”). Plead time and place where material (URCP 9(g)). Mark facts not yet confirmed in yellow brackets. Plead facts, not law or case citations.]]
